admission_shapes.table: 3x8/4x6/2x12 admitted; 6x4/12x2/24x1 REFUSED ('only 5 concurrent phase jobs fit'); all admitted at 220G (out of scope: 96G allocation)
admission_shapes.consequence: Worker scaling is memory-capped at 5 concurrent jobs, not the 8x CPU-filling the Astra table sketched. Measured barrier scaling confirms ~75% efficiency per added worker.

public_one_step_corner.evidence: run_utci_tiles refuses metfiles with <=2 rows: ValueError('Own-met input must contain multiple rows, as required by the pinned public driver')
public_one_step_corner.consequence: 1-step and 2-step public runs do not exist; per Astra guidance the corner is labelled unsupported rather than replayed. Run-phase fixed cost is taken from the child profile instead (27.4 s outside engine).

candidate_1_export_loop_concurrency.lever: the serial parent export loop (2746.9 s in the best arm) is per-tile independent, integrity-mandated read-back verification + atomic staged publication; concurrency is a scheduling change, not a numerical one
candidate_1_export_loop_concurrency.projection: 5-way -> ~550-690 s -> phase ~975-1265 s with twin+5x4 -> chain 58.7-63.6 min vs 110.2 = 1.73-1.88x overall
candidate_1_export_loop_concurrency.contract_surface: _precompute_geometry_phase docstring pins 'public outputs and their order are unchanged' (sorted-prefix publication on failure); concurrency changes write order and failure-truncation shape -> requires explicit documented amendment + tests; process-based (GIL-bound verify); no fork after parallel-region init

candidate_2_twin_dispatch_plus_shape.lever: bitwise phase-level measured: phase 4069.9 -> 3101.9 (1.312x) at 5x4 with child twin; barrier 3.82x
candidate_2_twin_dispatch_plus_shape.implementation: dispatch svf shadow -> sky_compiled.shadow_pixel_parallel (production entry, bush fallback embedded); shape policy 3x8 -> 5x4 subject to admission (5 fit)
